```yaml
name: Lazer Sui Contract CI

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    paths:
      - 'lazer/contracts/sui/**'
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Sui CLI
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y curl
          # Pin to a specific Sui CLI release
          curl -L https://github.com/MystenLabs/sui/releases/download/v0.9.0/sui-linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar xz
          sudo mv sui-linux-amd64/sui /usr/local/bin/
        shell: bash

      - name: Run Sui contract tests
        run: sui move test
        working-directory: lazer/contracts/sui
```
